task:
Use the chrome-use skill to connect to the user's existing/authenticated Chrome. MANDATORY browser hygiene (founder order): every tab you open, YOU close when done. Pattern: open -> act -> capture evidence -> CLOSE. Pin your own tab explicitly (re-verify by URL before every action) since this Chrome has other concurrent activity — do NOT assume tab indices stay stable.

Goal: Upload the video at /tmp/ocm_short_final.mp4 (21.3s, 1080x2400 vertical, already verified: 30fps, no bugs/errors/blank frames, real OpenCode Mobile app footage) as a YouTube Short to the VibeTechnologies channel (account vibeteaichnologies@gmail.com — this is the corporate/company account, NOT any personal account).

Steps:
1. Open a NEW tab (note its id) and navigate to https://studio.youtube.com
2. Verify you're on the correct channel/account (VibeTechnologies, vibeteaichnologies@gmail.com) — check the account avatar/channel switcher. If it's on the wrong Google account, use the account switcher to select the right one. If you cannot find/switch to the right account, STOP and report exactly what accounts are available instead of guessing.
3. Click Create -> Upload videos
4. On the file picker dialog, there will be an `input[type=file]` element — use it (not drag-and-drop) to select /tmp/ocm_short_final.mp4
5. Fill in:
   - Title: "OpenCode Mobile — AI coding agent in your pocket #Shorts"
   - Description: "Chat with an AI coding assistant from your phone. Connect to your own opencode server, or try the built-in demo. Free & open source. #opencode #AI #coding #mobiledev #Shorts"
   - Visibility: Public (this is meant to be a public demo Short)
6. Since it's a vertical video under 60s, YouTube should auto-detect it as a Short. Confirm the Shorts indicator appears.
7. Complete the upload wizard (skip monetization/other optional steps, use defaults) and publish.
8. After publishing, get the final YouTube Short URL (format like youtube.com/shorts/VIDEO_ID).
9. Take one screenshot as evidence of the published state showing the URL.
10. CLOSE the tab you opened for this task.

If you hit any blocker (wrong account with no switch option, upload stuck/failed, quota/policy rejection, 2FA wall), STOP and report the exact blocker — do not guess or force through.

Return: the final YouTube Short URL (or exact blocker), screenshot path, and confirmation the tab was closed.
